verwendet Serps GUIDS von 1500001025+1500001026+1500001029
you can set
ShouldBeShownInForeignObjectMenu
to 0 , to not disply the Buff in the ship UI.
This way the portrait wont be kind of "hidden" behind the UI anymore (blame ubisoft..)
set ShouldBeShownInForeignObjectMenu=0 by default now. Use my mod "DisplayBuffsFromOthers" if you want it to show
outcommented the line with ShouldBeShownInForeignObjectMenu to use the default value (which is 0 from vanilla and 1 if you have my mod DisplayBuffsFromOthers active)
Ships that reach max health higher than ~32k , eg. via items or code, will get destroyed on repairing -.-
therefore we will not increase health from ships, but give the ships an item/buff that decreases the damage they take
MilitaryShipPoints shows the AI how strong a ship is, unfortunately it is set on GUID base. and since the AI uses the same ships GUIDs like humans, changing the value does not solve anything
that is why the AI won't be able to properly see that their ships are stronger now, it may flee from a fight the AI might win thanks to the buff.
IgnoreDamageFactorUpgrade in VehicleUpgrade is regarding speed when damaged, so not what we are looking for
same buff guid and content and trigger guid like in my Stronger_Pirate_Ships_Serp/Buffed_GeneralEnemy_Ships_Serp mod. if it is not active, create it.
if it is active add to it.
<ShouldBeShownInForeignObjectMenu>0</ShouldBeShownInForeignObjectMenu>
needs some kind of reapply for the new sessions
It will renew the buffs for AI everytime the AI settles any Island, to make sure it is active in every session

Code by Serp:
Keybind Commands are only executed for the player who hit the button, which is most of the time exactly what we want.
But when changing the game speed in multiplayer, it must be executed for all players.
"ActionExecuteScript" does execute a script for all players at the same time, regardless which player triggered this action.
Although this is something we usually DONT want, in this case it is the solution for the multiplayer gamespeed.
extra trigger for notification started via ActionExecuteScript lua code, to make sure it is displayed for all players, not only the one who hit the button
- Fixed "Skip Monument Phase" command
- Added Keybind to increase reputation from the Owner of a selected object towards you
- made the "add one of each godlike" cheat also work when you did not unlock the research institut yet
Reworked the keybind system: Use Alt+C (downwards) and Alt+B (upwards) to select a cheat. Use Alt+V to trigger the selected cheat.
We can make these keybinds changeable in gamesettings, but it will revert to the keybinds here on every new game start (blame Ubi), so I save that time
if you want to add it, set Configurable=1, HideInOptionMenu=0 and add a <Text>TextGUID</Text> entry with the text of that option in menu

Reputation changes with NPCs for destroying pirates harbor / combackfleet:
We want AIs to react on the destroy of the pirates.
If they liked the pirates you will get negative Reputation and so on.
We want to show a notification that includes the reputation change, which is not as simple as it sounds. Only locations where I saw this happen are Reactions and Quest rewards.
So we either could make ~44 helper Quests with a reward and start them based on our conditions which compare each participant individually.
Or we are using the games reaction system, which is specially made for this purpose. (pirate is initiator of DiplomacyPiratesDefeated, wtf.. therefore this does not work to compare reputation)
Unfortunately the options are limited and the only reaction I found that can be used for this purpose (3 participants and a way to customize it with help of RequiredContextAsset)
is MilitaryShipDestroyed (or building). Alls the Quests or ShipSold Reactions don't accept a RequiredContextAsset and therefore can not be customized for specific circumstances

To Trigger this Reaction one ship needs to destroy another ship with our custom GUIDs. So we will spawn invisible Attacker and Victim Airships with low range and attack/hitpoints which should destroy eachother instantly and remove the left over within 3 seconds.
It should not be noteable by the user, but is indeed a quite heavy workaround, but still the best option I found.

general infor for lua and multiplayer:
Code with ActionExecuteScript is started for all humans, regardless who executed this Action.
If you only want to execute code for a specific human, you can use my WhichPlayerCondition mod (included as shared mod)
to check within the Trigger where you do ActionExecuteScript which human the executing player is and then start
a different script for each of them, eg called myscript_0.lua for Human0 and so on.
In that script you know its ment to be only executed for Human0, you can check "GetGetCurrentParticipantID" to make
sure only the correct participant is executing the code.
But your code still will be executed for all human peers in that Coop team, so if 2 people are in the team, lua commands
which are synced will still be executed 2 times.
To complete solve the coop problem, you will need my UltraTools shared mod. But even without it there are several workarounds
for specific situations. The MediumTools includes a few more workarounds.
But eg. instead of using "RegisterTriggerForCurrentParticipant", which will register the trigger 2 times with 2 coop players,
you can instead make your Trigger a FeatureUnlock (AutoSelfUnlock=0, AutoRegister=1), which has the main Condition UnlockNeeded of itself.
Then you can use ts.Unlock.SetUnlockNet(YOUR_FEATUREUNLOCK) instead, to make this Trigger start. It does not matter if the unlocking is executed
multiple times in coop, because unlock is unlock. (if you want to exeucte it multiple times, reset your trigger after ~500 ms)
IMPORTANT:
But by using Condition UnlockNeeded we get another problem:
Registered Triggers are saved to the samegame and Assets which do not exist are always counted as unlocked.
That means if a user deactivates your mod, the Trigger Code will still be there, but the asset he checks for being unlocked
does not exist anymore, which defaults to "unlocked" and make your Trigger execute its actions.
Depending on the actions this might cause problems, since the mod is no longer active.
Therefore its best to reverse the unlock for Triggers/FeatureUnlocks like this:
Use DefaultLockedState=0 for it and use NegateCondition in your UnlockNeeded Condition, to check if it is "locked".
And in lua you use instead ts.Unlock.SetRelockNet(YOUR_FEATUREUNLOCK)
I think for Quests PreConditionList this problem does not exist, at least not if Quest and Pool is removed (maybe if pool stays)

this t_FnViaTextEmbed is extremly powerful and helpful!
But please READ every comment I write about it, its important that you use it correctly, otherwise it may break for you and other mods using it!
t_FnViaTextEmbed is used to execute your custom lua code via ThirdPartyButton on CharacterNotification (which can only execute textembeds, not lua code)

it also makes sure that only the Peer who clicked the Button executes the code (by storing the CompanyName-change only for him and resetting it quite fast (its a delay of ~200 ms before the script is called))
gets called via Trigger 1500005600 , which is Registered eg via CharacterNotification Buttons:

<Command>[Unlock RelockNet(1500005600)];[Participants Participant(121) Profile SetCompanyName(g_ObjectFinderSerp.IsLoadedSessionByID|2|false)];[Conditions RegisterTriggerForCurrentParticipant(1500005600)]</Command>
using unsynced CompanyName from "Scenario3_Challenger4 GUID: 101507 , PID: 121" and "Scenario3_Challenger5 GUID: 101508 , PID: 122" as helper.
several characters are not allowed in Names, so use "|" to seperate functionname from arguments
Executing textembeds this way roughly takes 2 ticks (200ms) or 4 ticks in Multiplayer before the result can be fetched eg from other conditions
Important including textembeds:
textembeds within SetCompanyName in the Command does not work good. It will remove ALL text except this textembed result
so eg. SetCompanyName(hallo[AssetData(11715) Text])]hallo[AssetData(11507) Text])] only becomes "Handelsrouten", nothing more
Thats why DONT use any textembeds in 121. You can use up to 1 textembed in 122 instead (and only this textembed)
and write usetextembed as argument in 121, eg.:

<Command>[Unlock RelockNet(1500005600)];[Participants Participant(121) Profile SetCompanyName(g_sellable_serp.t_SimpleSellSelected|usetextembed|true|false)];[Participants Participant(122) Profile SetCompanyName([NotificationContext Value(TraderIndex) Int])];[Conditions RegisterTriggerForCurrentParticipant(1500005600)]</Command>

Before doing your <Command> in eg a xml trigger, first check if 1500005600 is unlocked ! If it is locked, this fn is currently in use and you need to wait!!
For CharacterNotification with player interaction, use <ActiveCallback>[Unlock IsUnlocked(1500005600)]</ActiveCallback>
In addition you might want to check if 1500005606 is unlocked, because CharacterNotification do NOT WORK within the first ~3 seconds of a new game.

- Made earlier Fregatte unlock savegame compatible.
- made sure everything is compatible to game version 16.1
- Added flamethrower Monitor to Late (1) and Endgame (6) pirate Fleet
- slightly increased the combackfleet in Late and Endgame
- comeback fleet in Late und Endgame now consists of ship of the line and monitor, instead of only one type.

- made counterproposals 3 times more expensive (eg. when you request ceasefire but the pirate does not like you enough to accept it for free). This may be adjusted in case ubisoft fixes the bug: that this cost do not scale with progress.
- code adjustments and bugfix of 1.03 (counterproposal cost change most likely did not work in 1.03)
- Added battlecrusier to the normal pirate fleet (1 in late und 3 in endgame).
- Increased amount of flamethrowers ships from pirates in Lategame from 1 to 3.
- Increased archibald and sarmentos harbor range, so pirate avoids a bigger radius around them to not be targetet by the guns that often.
- Halfed the CraftingTime of the pirates ships, so they spawn them faster and doubled their selfheal when out of combat (still very slow).
- increased quest time limit to defeat comeback-fleet from 10 to 15 minutes (vanilla 30 minutes)

- If not in war with pirates, they have a 50% chance to ask every 30 minutes for money, if they are stronger than you. If not paid they will cancel treaties or even declare war, even if they liked you.

- If not in war and the pirates don't like you (anymore), they will only declare/threat war if they are at least half as strong as you (unless the reputation is below 1, then the strength does not matter)
- Fixed LaFortune Resettle (maybe he previously spawned Harlow ships in old world.. my code was wrong)
- The whole resettle group will now spawn at the same location (ships added by this mod previously spawned random).

- You are offered CaeseFire with both pirates at gamestart and treaty is war also with LaFortune. This way you can safely settle your first island and have an exact timer when war will start with the pirates.

- Pirate ships will now also attack/hunt your warships when you come too close. This was added to make sure they don't simply ignore warships shooting on them. Unfortunately there is no way to make them act perfectly right, so downside may mean they will also attack if your ship is stronger. (because wen can only convert this "ignore ships of specific strenght" to attack or to flee)
- Pirates will spawn a ship of each kind (once every 20 minutes one ship, up to 2 ships of each kind), to make sure in the later progressions pirates have some diversity of ships.
- Increased Comeback timer from 1 hour to 2 hours again (vanilla 2.5 hours) so it is more rewarding to defeat them.
- increased Island-repair timer from 5 minutes to 10 minutes (vanilla 25 minutes) to allow a fast second attack if the first fails.
- bugfix in the code to spawn a pirate ship every 20 minute (was not active in 1.06 therefore).
- Added few flamethrower ship and battlecruiser to comebackfleet of Late and Endgame.
- increased MilitaryDefensePoints for pirate harbor and turrets, so the AI knows they are stronger. This also increases the pirates militarystrenght.
- Made the regular money request from pirates if you are in peace or higher more expensive (min 50k). CounterProposal of pirate is still vanilla cheap.
- Nerf SelfHeal from pirate harbor, vanilla is 300, while the highest selfheal from other things is 10! Set it 50.
- add flak monitor to endgame warfleet
- removed "shorter CeaseFire+NonAttack"-code, use the standalone mod with that name instead.
- you can only request CeaseFire once per hour from pirate (together with "shorter ceasefire-mod" this means you have to fight at least 15 minutes or make peace)
- updated shared mod PirateDefeatHelpers and fixed the LaFortune Trigger to spawn some ships not working.
- more money rewards in my "rewards destroy pirates mod" if you also use it
- added flak on top of pirate harbour buildings, thanks Ac3s for permission to use his code.
- updated shared_PirateDefeatHelpers to be more compatible
- updated shared_PirateDefeatHelpers to make sure the helper Quests are not accidently included in a Questpool
- added military_attention_pirates to incompatible mods list

Most Common Problem that this mod tries to solve/make less of a pain:
If one wants to apply global buffs with ActionBuff/AddBuff, they must be applied to every newly entered session again.
One could solve this by making a trigger that checks once for each Session eg. by ConditionActiveSession and hardcoding all known Session GUIDs here.
This should work fine for all the Session GUIDs you mentioned here and should be enough to execute this once per Session.
While this is the most efficient way, it can only support the sessions you explicit mentioned with GUID. It can not support other (mod-)sessions.
That is why many modders use SessionEnter instead, because this triggers everytime the user switches session and catches this way also unknown session GUIDs.
Downside is that it triggers everytime on switching session and depending on the number of buffs/the buff-targets this might lag a short time,
which sucks if it happens on every session switching.

(You can also not use an SessionLoaded Event, because AddBuf only works if the user already visited the session or owns an object in it, which is not the case when SessionLoaded fires, especially if eg. AI made the session load, then the human may be far from entering that session)
Since this one resets everytime the user loads a savegame, it also resets everytime the user changes mods.
so this means using this shared mod is easier to use to add global buffs than my OncePerSession_xml mod, which remembers if it already fired for a session forever

Balancing:
every ~30 to 60 minutes a chance to spawn spies.
spies will spawn and ~10 seconds later you will get a notification that somewhere was a spy spotted.

There are 2 major way to hide/show the different option as AssemblyOptions in this shipyard-like building:
1) switch between lock/unlock/unhide (locking also hides)
2) Using a Buff with AddAssemblyOptions

We will use the 2) one here, because locking will be used instead to 1) mark a setting as currently chosen and 2) other mods can check the chosen setting by checking what is locked (locked means chosen)
(Beware, the lock of ObjectDummyWithOwner_BuildInShipyard-Assets are only changed for the player who did the setting, not for all!

for general settings that should affect everyone you need to add a new unlockableasset and change its lock state for all if one player changes settings, see my disaster mods for example diff_settings_disaster.lua )

System to spawn a helper Dummy Building on every island the player owns, keep it for 10 seconds and then delete it again.
This can be used to identify the current highest ObjectID of the island and helps ALOT when searching for a specific
building. Feel free to create your own Helper Quests based on this system to be more efficient (eg you are searching for building x
then only spawn a helper building in islands which have building X on it)

local count = ts.Participants.GetParticipant(0).ProfileCounter.Stats.GetCounter(0,0,1500005548,3)

ts.GetGameObject(OID) also works for many things with objects in other sessions, but unfortunately not all of them.
So first test if this is working for the thing you want to do. If not then you can use the following workaround.
textsourcelist.json shows that there is a ts.MetaObjects.SessionGameObject(OID) command to retrive GameObjects from other sessions.
But for whatever reason this is not available in lua directly -.-
As far as I know it can only be used in "text embeds" also used in infotips.
See here https://github.com/anno-mods/modding-guide/blob/main/Scripting/textembeds.md
and here https://github.com/anno-mods/modding-guide/blob/main/documentation/infotips.md for more information.
Eg instead of using
ts.MetaObjects.SessionGameObject(OID).ItemContainer.CheatItemInSlot(193195,1)
we need to convert this to a text-embed string first:
"[MetaObjects SessionGameObject("..tostring(OID)..") ItemContainer CheatItemInSlot(193195,1)]"
(note that lua often needs "Set" and "Get" in front of the commands, while textembeds mostly don't (they use the exact wording you find in textsourcelist))
To call this in lua we can use the function game.TextSourceManager.setDebugTextSource(String).
So in total: game.TextSourceManager.setDebugTextSource("[MetaObjects SessionGameObject("..tostring(OID)..") ItemContainer CheatItemInSlot(193195,1)]")
Unfortunately this setDebugTextSource function does not return the result of the text-embed ...
to still get return values I only found the workaround to have an invisible Nameable-helper-object ingame,
from which we will change the name to the result of this string within the textembed.
This way we can retrieve everything that can be saved as a string in a Name.

Known Issues (not fixable):
1) If an island is lost while the Eruption-Quest is active, the Quest and therefore the Eruption of volcano is aborted. (and restarted again, so the timer starts from new)
(this is because of the StarterObject-building on the island is for whatever reason removed in this case, although its Neutral and also OwnerChangeTarget does not help.
only way to solve this would be a Starter that does not belong to the island, like a ship, but the Starter is important to define the QuestArea and also QuestSession
with a ship both of these stay undefined unfortunately, which makes spawning all the helper objects around the volcano impossible (only possible if only 1 volcano wordwide exists))

(we use a Quest for this, because I don't know another way to define a QuestArea. It does not work with PlayerCounter+Scope=Area, because this can only check islands owned by processing player, so espeically no unsettled islands)

2) If an island was taken over/got the shares after a War, the forced CeaseFire of the island makes all buildings on the island not targetable by any attacks, even from Volcano (General_Enemy+PirateFalg)
No way to fix this besides disabling this forced CeaseFire, which of course is not an option..

3) Only one Eruption worldwide at the same time is possible, because CounterScope=Session can not define QuestSession and also not check if a session has several things in common (unlike CounterScope=Area)
(only workaround would be hardcoded Session GUIDs, but for now I want the volcano spawn in every session, even mod sessions)
4) if you play coop multiplayer:
the volcano can only spawn in a session where a coop-leader (first slot in coop team) is currently active.
that means if no coop-leader is anymore participating in the game, the volcano will only spawn in the session where he was the last.

Die Ziele werden nicht angezeigt, wenn:
- die Objekt GUID direkt als Ziel genannt wird (vermutung, nicht getestet)
- die objekt GUID auf oberster Ebene des effectpools gelistet ist, welcher das ziel des buffs ist.
Besonders letzteres hat zur Folge, dass der tooltip bei verschachtelten pools in pools angezeigt wird,
aber bei pools wo dann direkt zb. alle schiffe gelistet sind, er nicht angezeigt wird.
Obwohl es hier keinerlei lofischen Grund gibt, die ziele nicht anzuzeigen.
Wann wäre es sinnvoll die Ziele nicht zu zeigen:
1) Wenn das Objekt das einzige Ziel ist und direkt ohne pool als target genannt wurde.
2) Wenn es sehr viele Ziele sind, vorallem wenn es keine pools, sondern objekte selbst sind.
Ich vermute
<Condition>[ToolOneHelper IsObjectEffectTarget([Selection Object GUID], [RefGuid])]</Condition>
funktioniert nicht wie gewollt, eigentlich sollte es direkte targets im buff erkennen, und nicht eine einzige ebene in einen genannten pool gehen.

This mod "fixes" (impossible to fix, just adding workarounds):

- If you save and load a savegame, while the Quest to destroy the comeback fleet is active, this quest will end and a new comeback fleet will arrive after "ComebackAfterKontorDestruction"-time, resulting in 2 or more comeback fleets.

-> fixed by removing the current comebackfleet when loading such a savegame. You still have to wait for the next, but at least there won't be 2 or more comebackfleets at once anymore. (this comeback-stuff is mostly outside of xml, so there is no proper way to simply start the Quest again on loading without the need to wait for the next fleet, that is why I chose this solution)

- If the Comeback Fleet arrives while you are not at war with pirates (eg. AI destroyed them or you used pirate flag item), then the ships will simply stand next to the harbor doing nothing. You have to save+load the game, declare war and wait for the next fleet to bypass this.

-> fixed by making pirates declare war on every human they not already have war with while they are defeated. I removed my complicated code that was ment to restore previous relation as soon as comebackfleet arrives, because I agree, that it is fine to get this kind of punishment for not helping the pirates to not be defeated.
Pirates do not declare war to AIs with this fix, because I do not wanted to mess with AI personalities (may be stupid if Ais that would never be at war with pirates, suddenly are at war with them)
- Comeback Fleet does not change to neutral and not leaving the map, after pirate island is destroyed again.
-> fixed by changing owner of all pirate ships from pirate to neutral and tell them to leave map, as soon as pirate is defeated.
- In multiplayer the players 2 to 4 will now also start with peace towards the new world pirate La Fortune, just like player 1
- Warfleet of pirates get neutral and leaves map when pirate harbor is destroyed, even if the pirate itself is not defeated yet and can rebuild harbor if not completely defeated in time.
-> COULD be "fixed" by commanding on harbor destroy all neutral pirate ships to move back to pirate harbor and change owner to pirate again, if pirate is not defeated yet.

BUT unfortunately this way the warfleet is no longer recognized as warfleet from pirate, so if the pirate repairs his kontor without being defeated, he will spawn a new warfleet over time, resulting in more ships then intended. In addition these ships will act the same like comebackfleet, so only attack/defend, but no roaming around.

So instead: we made the pirate harbor invincible. Destroy all pirate guns instead to defeat the pirate. This makes sure the harbor gets destroyed at the same time automatically the pirate is defeated, so it is no problem anymore that the game removes the warfleet on harbor destroy.
- Comeback Fleet does not count to the WarFleet count of pirates (so pirates will have the comeback fleet plus the warfleet amount after resettle -> more than intended)

-> fixed by commanding one of the resettle ships every 45 minutes to leave map (without changing to neutral) as long as pirate is not defeated. But (Ac3s) likes the extreme, this trigger is not active if Combat Overhaul-Pirates mod is active.
- Warfleet does not spawn again after comeback if you defeated pirate while he had full warfleet. It does start spawn again after you destroyed at least one comebackfleet ship after rebuild.
-> also fixed by the previous fix which removes a comebackfleet ship every 45 minutes (starting 15 minutes after rebuild)

- comebackfleet regulary aborts the default pirates SquadLogic (roaming around) and stand still doing nothing, eg whenever there is a attack/defend Command (which is when island building gets attacked or a fixed time intervall for attacks).

It seems the game devs only implemented this for the internally spawned WarFleet, while ships spawned differently or ships that left the warfleet (which happens on harbor destroy for the current warfleet) only activate this "roaming around" once after the owner of the ships was changed to Pirate.

-> COULD be "fixed" by: Every 30 minutes this fixmod will change the owner of all pirate ships for a milisecond to neutral and then back to pirate, to make sure all ships are doing their job (will make the ships stop moving 1 second, but then they will continue doing what they did before).
BUT this also disrupts active attacks from the ships, so we decided against it. Instead it is ok if comebackfleet is just for attacking/defending, not for roaming around.
- Comeback Fleet on their way to pirates harbor is owned by "General_Enemy" and therefore also shooting (drive by) at players the pirate is not at war with.

-> "fixed" automatically by the fix of 3). Now pirates will be at war with all humans when comebaclfleet arrives, so it is no problem that ships are owned by General_enemy and shooting at everyone. (ok they will still shoot at AIs they are at peace, but I don't think this is that important)
- Although the comebackfleet as "UseDangerLayer=1" defined, they still simply drive through island denfense and get shot.
-> not fixed. See no proper way to fix this, beside making the ComebackFleet Neutral until it reaches the harbor, but I don't think this would be a good solution.

Combat Overhaul spawns the comebackfleet in multiple smaller fleets with different spawnpoints to reduce the chance all ships drive towards a defense. But this also increases the chance that some ships will drive towards defense. I will keep this untouched.

If you want sth to happen with different chances based on circumstance, you may try a Trigger with multiple SubTriggers checking for your custom unlocks.

I mean eg. you do 11 "UnlockableAsset" and call them 0%, 10%, 20% up to 100%. Then in the trigger you check for these unlocks with MutuallyExclusive. While using ConditionMutualAreaInSubconditions there seems to be an exception to how the Conditions are checked.

Normally, if you put several SubTrigger on the same level, they must NOT be true at the same time to trigger the main actions, but it is enough if each of them was true in the past at least once, regardless of the other.
But when using ConditionMutualAreaInSubconditions the subtriggers must be written on the same level, otherwise ConditionMutualAreaInSubconditions can not check if they are the same Area.

ALWAYS fullfilled for Objects having this property, regardless if we check for True/False or anything else!

CompareOperator==1 == NOT this GUID

This mod adds support for custom visitor piers and custom hotels to show the correct infotips used in vanilla assets.
Visitor Pier support is done by replacing vanilla conditions which use harcoded guids for exceptions, with more general conditions based on properties a certain building has
Conditions which check for properties an asset has...
are always TRUE, if the property is present in an asset
are always FALSE, if the property is not present in an asset
Therefore it is not possible to check if an asset does not have a certain property
Example
Asset A: has properties 1 2 3 4
Asset B: has properties 2 3 4
Asset C: has properties 2 3 4 5
Now a condition wants to check for : "Asset has not property 5"
Intuitive result would be: Asset A = True; Asset B = True; Asset C = False
However the actual result due to the logic above is: Asset A = False; Asset B = False; Asset C = True -> this is obvisiously not what we wanted to check, but the opposite
Oil Harbour has IsWarehouse, Visitor Pier doesn´t, therefore this property can be used to distinguish both
Visitor Pier has VisitorPier, Oil Harbour doesn´t, therefore this property can be used to distinguish both
Hotel infotips support is done by replacing vanilla conditions which use harcoded guids for exceptions with conditions whether tourists live in the selected asset

dann werden in der mod assets.xml beim hovern über ne GUID zb angezeigt was es ist. Mit strg+Leertaste werden ein paar Autovervollständigungen vorgeschlagen (zb Template namen)
Und wenn man ein oder mehrere (alle) modops im Mod markiert, rechtsklick und "anno Compare result with vanilla" klickt,

dann kann man direkt die modänderungen einsehen um zu testen, ob es so geändert wurde, wie gewünscht. wichtig ist noch in im xml extension von redhat die xsd zuzufügen, xml file association: "xml.fileAssociations": [ { "pattern": "assets*.xml", "systemId": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anno-mods/vscode-anno-modding-tools/main/generated/assets.xsd" } ] Hilfreiche Funktionen: in der mod assets.xml kann man auf GUID="x" die maus drüberhalten und sieht wie das objekt heißt. Mit rechtsclick go to definition öffnet sich ein neues fenster mit dem kompletten eintrag davon, für bessere übersicht über diees asset. Man kann den Modordner in VSC öffnen (open folder) und hat dann da eine übersicht und weitere rechtclick funktionen über die Dateien. zb wohl auch rechtsklick auf eine language text datei mit "update from english" oderso, wodurch die englische Übersetzung in die anderen text dateien übertragen wird (bzw. weiteree dateien angelegt werdden) Kann auch "Build and Deploy" und damit unter andrem Graphiken in allen nötigen größen umwandeln mit _0 _1 _2 usw. Falls noch wer dasselbe Problem hat die VS-code Erweiterung zu aktualisieren: die anno extension konnte ich update, indem ich im extension menu die drei punkte geklickt und "check for Extension updates" gemacht hab (obwohl auto-update aktiv ist, hat er das nicht automatisch gemacht) und bzgl. RedHat XML Extension xsd cache: keine ahnung wies offiziell geht, aber ich hab hier einfach den "cache" gelöscht und VS neugestartet, dann hat er das neue xsd runtergeladen: C:\Users\Serpens66\.lemminx\cache\https\raw.githubusercontent.com\anno-mods\vscode-anno-modding-tools\main\generated mittlerweile sind auch die Autocompletes mit properties-toolone und datasets.xml geupdated. Zb. einfach in <ObjectParticipantID></ObjectParticipantID> zb Strg+Leertaste drücken um alle datasets.xml Einträge vorgeschlagen zu bekommen!

Funktionsweisen von add, remove, replace, merge, AddNextSibling, AddPrevSibling: Vector nennt man zb dieses konstrukt: <EarlyGame> <PreferedGoods> <Item> <Product>1010216</Product> <PriceMultiplier>2.5</PriceMultiplier> <ReputationMultiplier>1.5</ReputationMultiplier> </Item> </PreferedGoods> </EarlyGame> merge: löscht keine vorhandenen Einträge, fügt aber hinzu und ändert vorhandene Einträge (aber ersetzt sie nicht mit leeren Eintrag) Funktioniert nicht mit "Item" einträgen, also bezeichnungen die mehrfach vorkommen. Der Pfad sollte den zb: <Attackable> <MaximumHitPoints>8000</MaximumHitPoints> <SelfHealPerHealTick>10</SelfHealPerHealTick> </Attackable> <Attacker> <BaseDamage>200</BaseDamage> </Attacker> muss attacker wie im original nach attackable kommen! und hitpoints vor heal! Seit GU 17.1 (data28) kann es auch Listen (zb. <Item>) mergen, zb: <ModOp Type="merge" GUID="100780" Path="/Values/Maintenance"> <Maintenances> <Item> <Product>1010017</Product> <Amount>50000</Amount> <InactiveAmount>300</InactiveAmount> </Item> <Item /> <Item> <Product>1010367</Product> <Amount>50</Amount> </Item> </Maintenances> </ModOp> WICHTIG hierbei ist dann doch wieder die REIHENFOLGE (nur bei Listen) deswegen ist der leere <Item /> eintrag zb wichtig, damit der vorhandene zweite eintrag unverändert beibehalten wird. Achtung: merge übernimmt keine leeren einträge, wenn es den schon gibt, also das funzt nicht um einige einträge leer zu machen!: <ModOp Type="merge" GUID='141170' Path="/Values/ElectricityFeature"> <ElectricWire1/> <ElectricWire2/> <ElectricWire3/> <ElectricWire4/> <ElectricWire5/> <ElectricPoleStraight>977600</ElectricPoleStraight> <ElectricPoleCrossing/> <ElectricPoleCorner/> <ElectricPoleTCross/> <ElectricPoleRailway/> </ModOp> aber hinzufügen tut es solche leeren einträge, wenn es sie noch nicht gibt, was auch wichtig sein kann (Wird von mir schon viel genutzt) ACHTUNG bei Befehlen die direkt auf die unterste Ebene gehen: <ModOp Type="merge" GUID="269978" Path="/Values/FactoryUpgrade/ProductivityUpgrade/Value"> <Value>0</Value> </ModOp> Da hier im Pfad "Value" vorgegeben ist, wird Value also nur da angepasst, wo es den eintrag bereits gab, er wird NICHT zugefügt, weil der Pfad vorgibt, dass nach Value geguckt wird! Trigger Conditions WICHTIG
Subtrigger conditions auf derselben ebene müssen bei Parallel/Linear NICHT zurselben Zeit wahr sein, damit Haupttrigger erfüllt wird!

Aber nur solange die HauptCondition des Triggers wahr ist, werden die subtrigger conditions überhaupt geprüft, dh. wenn ich 1 Hauptrigger und 1 subcondition habe, dann müssen diese beiden gleichzeitg wahr sein.
<SubConditionCompletionOrder>Parallel</SubConditionCompletionOrder>
heißt alle subtrigger werden gleichzeitig ausgeführt und überprüft, egal welche wahr/unwahr ist. Nur nachdem alle subtrigger einmal wahr waren, ist Trigger fertig.

Linear heißt sie werden nacheinander ausgeführt und nur wenn die vorangegangene subtrigger condition einmal wahr war wird bei der nächsten Bedingung weiter gemacht. Nur nachdem alle subtrigger einmal wahr waren, ist Trigger fertig.
heißt dass nur der erste (reihenfolge wichtig) subtrigger mit der subcondition die wahr ist weiter ausgeführt wird, die anderen subtrigger werden nicht mehr geprüft und der Haupttrigger ist fertig

bereits getriggerte Trigger-GUIDs werden im Savegame gespeichert, sodass eine nachträgliche Änderung an dieser GUID keine wikrung auf das savegame hat,
da der gesamte trigger als "erledigt" gilt.

Wenn der Trigger aber schon vorher einen Reset enthält und im savegame dann resetted wird, greift natürlich der neue code. Einen ResetTrigger zu einem bereits getriggerten Trigger im code nachzutragen, sorgt nicht dafür dass dieser im savegame ausgeführt wird.
Wenn der Mod mit einem erledigtem Trigger und auch einem Unlock deaktiviert und das spiel ohne den mod gespeichert wird,
dann wird offenbar die trigger und unlock GUID auch aus dem savegame gelöscht (sind also nicht fired und nicht unlocked)
und ein erneutes aktivieren des Mods in dem Savegame löst den Trigger erneut aus, zb um er erneut zu unlocken

testen ob Infolayer von ConditionQuestObjective/ConditionObjectiveSignsAndFeedback oder
von ConditionStarterObject/ConditionObjectiveSignsAndFeedback verwendet wird.
Antwort: Der Eintrag in ConditionQuestObjective wird verwendet. Wenn nichts in ConditionQuestObjective definiert,
kommt es aus dem template von ConditionStarterObject, welches ConditionQuestObjective und darin ein InfoLayer enthält.
Wenn man InfoLayer aus diesem Template entfernt, wird ConditionStarterObject/ConditionObjectiveSignsAndFeedback auch nicht verwendet, sondern es kommt so ein "Questgegenstand einsammeln"-Infolayer.

auch das MinimapToken kommt aus ConditionQuestObjective/ConditionObjectiveSignsAndFeedback obwohl es im ConditionStarterObject nicht explizit definiert ist.
doch darin wird Template ConditionObjectiveSignsAndFeedback verwendet und dieses hat das MiniMapToken definiert.

Accuracy Erklärung von Taube:
AccuracyByDistance is an accuracy curve over the shooting distance. Lower value means better dispersion, If I am not mistaken CorrespondingAccuracy is the factor on the accuracy at that range.
base accuracy: higher values -> worse dispersion
accuracy increase over distance -> the minimum of the dispersion curve is AccuracyBase, maximum is AccuracyIncreaseOverDistance * AccuracyBase iirc.
And just in case: Big, hard hitting ships with long range and good accuracy at long range are a recipe for disastrous balancing. You just die when fighting them with anything else
Oh, and if the target does not have hit and miss dummies, all your shots hit, rendering accuracy worthless.
Keep this in mind when creating new attackable harbor buildings or ships.

See the SotL as example. It has really terrible dispersion.
AccuracyBase: 5
AccuracyIncreaseOverDistance: 100, so you end up with an Accuracy of 10 at max range.
Also, the dispersion curve increases the dispersion much more sharply at shorter ranges. At only 40% of the MaxRange, you already have a 70% increase in dispersion.

Then see the gunboat for some better dispersion values. The curve is linear and just has the entries 0% at short range, 100% at max range, so it's a linear increase, it has a BaseAccuracy of 5 and a AccuracyIncreaseOverDistance of 80, so it can bring DPS into the fight reliably. The SotL is designed to come close (well, at least on paper. The actual damage of the thing mean that it's still the best ship by far. You can hit like only 50% of your shells and are still better than the battlecruiser)
Tests von ac3s:
So after extensive testing these are my conclusions:
<AccuracyBase>, xxx-0, higher number means LOWER overall accuracy (if AccuracyBase = 0 then other settings about accuracy have no or very limited impact, except for AccuracySpeedDecay)
<AccuracySpeedDecay>, 0 or 20, how much the ship will miss if enemy is moving, 0 = no misses, 20 = some misses
<AccuracyIncreaseOverDistance>, 100-0, higher number means LOWER accuracy, 100 = NO increase, 0 = max increase in accuracy THE CLOSER the enemy gets to you
<EnemyDistanceRelToAttackRange>, 0-100, 0 being right on top of your ship, 100 being the maximum of your ship's range
<CorrespondingAccuracy>, 100-0, higher number means LOWER accuracy
also I think I see a corrolation here:
We can either go with <AccuracyIncreaseOverDistance>100 (meaning its OFF) and then <AccuracyByDistance> with several items (meaning we manually make our own)
Or we can go with <AccuracyIncreaseOverDistance> lower than 100 (meaning its ON) and then <AccuracyByDistance> with only 2 items, 0-100/100-100 (meaning its OFF)

infotips:
Alle Werte sind wenn nicht definiert 0.
ElementType=1 scheint überschrift zu sein, groß und hat darunter einen Strich.
CompareOperator. möglich dass wenn keiner erwähnt wird, default "größer als 0" oder "größergleich 1" ist.
0 Equals
1 Unequals
2 smaller than
3 smaller than or equal
4 bigger than or equal
5 bigger than
<OperatorType>1</OperatorType> ist denke ich eine "oder" verknüpfung. Normalerweise sind zb. nacheinander geschaltete VisibilityElement
Bedingungen dafür, dass ein text angezeigt wird und sie sind "und" verknüpft. Aber wenn man OperatorType=1 auf selber ebene setzt, ist es wohl "oder"
ElementType=4 ist attribut, also zb: "Geschwindigkeit: 10"
ElementType=5 ist dunkelgrauer "hintergrund" text.
ElementType=7 wird anscheinend für loops im zusammenhang mit #index0# und Source verwendet
ElementType=19 ist vermutlich eine Auflistung von attributen, wird zb verwendet zsm mit <TemplateGUID>454144439</TemplateGUID>, welches alle buff properties eines objects ausliest und dann auflistet

Erklärung von Taube 28.8.2023:

Die Ausführung eines Scripts blockiert für den gesamten Zeitraum den restlichen Gamethread. Updates an bestimmten Properties (wie z.B. Lager) werden jedoch erst beim nächsten Gametick umgesetzt, daher ist Read After Write immer ein wenig problematisch
Glücklicherweise haben wir eine Möglichkeit, das Script als coroutine parallel zu den gameticks laufen zu lassen, bzw. funktionen von Anno parallel zu den gameticks laufen zu lassen.
In diesem Fall führt Anno pro Gametick das Script zwar blockend aus, aber immer nur bis zum nächsten yield. dann kommt der Gametick und damit läuft das script weiter.
Nach dem Write bekommt unser Script also ein coroutine.yield(), damit kann dann der nächste Gametick passieren
wir können außerdem asynchron mit system.waitForGameTimeDelta(ms) eine Anzahl Millisekunden abwarten, bis wir weitermachen.
Asynchron starten tun wir dann mit system.start(Function)
function RunTest()
local oldAmount = ts.Economy.MetaStorage.GetStorageAmount(1010017)
print(oldAmount)
local amount = 50000
ts.Economy.MetaStorage.AddAmount(1010017, amount)
local newAmount = ts.Economy.MetaStorage.GetStorageAmount(1010017)
print(newAmount)
end -- Read after Write: not okay. AddAmount needs writeback, which happens AFTER the function executes, solution coroutine.yield()
